title: Greentech wins top IFSCC award for breakthrough in neuro-pigmentation
summary: Greentech has received the 2026 IFSCC Grand Prize for Applied Research at the 36th International Federation of Societies of Cosmetic Chemists (IFSCC) Congress, held in Perth, Australia, for research highlighting the role of neuronal signaling in age-related hyperpigmentation. The IFSCC jury recognized a major breakthrough in understanding how skin ages and develops pigmentation. Greentech's research sheds light on the direct role of the nervous system in triggering localized melanin... - Science, R&D / publi-redac
